Investment Centers of America Inc. decreased its holdings in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) by 9.1% in the 3rd quarter, according to its most recent Form 13F filing with the SEC. The firm owned 163,833 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock after selling 16,347 shares during the period. Apple makes up approximately 1.9% of Investment Centers of America Inc.’s holdings, making the stock its 6th largest position. Investment Centers of America Inc.’s holdings in Apple were worth $25,257,000 as of its most recent filing with the SEC. 
Several other institutional investors and hedge funds have also made changes to their positions in AAPL. Janus Henderson Group PLC boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 301.3% during the second quarter. Janus Henderson Group PLC now owns 20,003,587 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $2,880,992,000 after buying an additional 15,018,790 shares during the period. Capital Research Global Investors boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 15.0% during the second quarter. Capital Research Global Investors now owns 29,449,961 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $4,241,383,000 after buying an additional 3,845,363 shares during the period. Arrowstreet Capital Limited Partnership boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 200.3% during the second quarter. Arrowstreet Capital Limited Partnership now owns 4,765,574 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $686,338,000 after buying an additional 3,178,809 shares during the period. Principal Financial Group Inc. boosted its stake in shares of Apple by 25.3% during the second quarter. Principal Financial Group Inc. now owns 10,582,632 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,524,110,000 after buying an additional 2,138,928 shares during the period. Finally, Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC raised its holdings in Apple by 21.6% during the second quarter. Parametric Portfolio Associates LLC now owns 11,991,909 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock worth $1,727,075,000 after purchasing an additional 2,132,900 shares in the last quarter. Apple Inc. ( NASDAQ AAPL ) opened at $179.98 on Friday. The firm has a market cap of $928,910.00, a price-to-earnings ratio of 17.61, a price-to-earnings-growth ratio of 1.33 and a beta of 1.22. Apple Inc. has a 1-year low of $138.62 and a 1-year high of $180.62. The company has a quick ratio of 1.20, a current ratio of 1.24 and a debt-to-equity ratio of 0.74. 
Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) last announced its quarterly earnings results on Thursday, February 1st. The iPhone maker reported $3.89 earnings per share for the quarter, beating the Zacks’ consensus estimate of $3.82 by $0.07. The company had revenue of $88.29 billion for the quarter, compared to analyst estimates of $87.62 billion. Apple had a net margin of 21.13% and a return on equity of 37.37%. Apple’s revenue for the quarter was up 12.7% on a year-over-year basis. During the same quarter last year, the business earned $3.36 EPS. equities research analysts expect that Apple Inc. will post 11.43 earnings per share for the current year. 
The business also recently declared a quarterly dividend, which was paid on Thursday, February 15th. Shareholders of record on Monday, February 12th were issued a $0.63 dividend. The ex-dividend date of this dividend was Friday, February 9th. This represents a $2.52 dividend on an annualized basis and a dividend yield of 1.40%. Apple’s dividend payout ratio (DPR) is presently 24.66%. 
Several research analysts recently issued reports on AAPL shares. UBS Group set a $190.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Tuesday, November 14th. Vetr raised shares of Apple from a “hold” rating to a “buy” rating and set a $177.17 price target for the company in a report on Wednesday, November 29th. Nomura set a $185.00 price target on shares of Apple and gave the stock a “buy” rating in a report on Monday, November 27th. Citigroup reissued a “buy” rating and set a $200.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Wednesday, December 13th. Finally, KeyCorp reissued a “buy” rating and set a $192.00 price target on shares of Apple in a report on Thursday, December 7th. One equities research analyst has rated the stock with a sell rating, eighteen have issued a hold rating, thirty-two have issued a buy rating and one has issued a strong buy rating to the stock. Apple currently has a consensus rating of “Buy” and an average target price of $201.57. 
In other Apple news, insider Daniel J. Riccio sold 15,641 shares of Apple stock in a transaction on Friday, January 5th. The shares were sold at an average price of $174.78, for a total value of $2,733,733.98. Following the transaction, the insider now owns 13,739 shares in the company, valued at approximately $2,401,302.42. The sale was disclosed in a document filed with the SEC, which can be accessed through the SEC website . 0.08% of the stock is owned by company insiders.
